north_star: Find source-backed, repeatable online business opportunities and reuse proven commerce, fulfillment, and proof capabilities across isolated silos.

universe_targets.meaning: Long-range ingestion target, not current coverage or a claim that 500000 businesses have been found or ranked.
universe_targets.profitability_claim_policy: A business may be called profitable only when a traceable source supports a stated period, currency, scope, and profit measure. Revenue, traffic, valuation, funding, reviews, and job postings are not profit.
universe_targets.candidate_hypotheses: The operator-supplied 500-item idea backlog is a hypothesis set, not verified demand, a list of businesses, or a revenue forecast.

pipeline.rule: Keep the source text or an allowed extract, timestamp, and content hash. No synthetic observations.
Deduplicate and preserve original source identity. Do not infer missing financial fields.
Separate observed buyer intent, paid demand, public revenue, disclosed profit, repeat purchase, and mere attention.
Score only against evidence. Missing evidence lowers confidence or blocks admission; it never becomes PASS.
Create hypothesis cells separately from observed opportunity records. Never label a generated cell as a buyer, business observation, or revenue.
Reuse the MTG master and existing commerce spine. Failed mechanisms stay small and are quarantined.
Publishing, outreach, checkout activation, purchases, credential changes, and irreversible production changes remain blocked until separately authorized.
Only a real settled external payment plus verified fulfillment can promote a commercial result. Internal scores and payment links are not revenue.

allowed_source_families: public company filings and audited annual reports
official public procurement and tender notices
public software issue trackers and feature requests
public job descriptions and contract requests
public marketplaces where access and reuse are permitted
public pricing pages and service catalogues
public creator and developer marketplaces with documented terms

hard_stops: Profit claim without a cited profit measure and period
Checkout and fulfillment do not match
Material rights, privacy, or safety issue unresolved
Required action crosses a forbidden mutation boundary

initial_execution_order.priority_reason: Existing MTG master silo and a high operator-provided candidate score make this the first bounded product audit. The score is not proof of demand.
allowed_actions: read current Stripe product and price metadata
write internal audit artifact on a branch
initial_execution_order.success_condition: A deterministic report identifies exact checkout, canonical SKU, settlement verification, input intake, fulfillment output, and proof gaps with source references.

initial_execution_order.priority_reason: Reuse the existing MTG stencil rather than cloning code and commerce logic per niche.
initial_execution_order.success_condition: Shared UI template, isolated inventory, explicit capability contract, and fail-closed activation gates are testable.

initial_execution_order.priority_reason: Existing route and registry exist, but forum, real-time chat, free listings, and paid promotion must be evidenced individually.
initial_execution_order.success_condition: No feature is labelled active without a verified backend, authorization boundary, persistence, and user-facing test.

initial_execution_order.priority_reason: Grow from permitted public source observations instead of fabricating a 500000-business list.
initial_execution_order.first_artifact: source-backed observation batch with freshness, deduplication, and evidence hashes
initial_execution_order.success_condition: Each record resolves to an allowed source and remains explicitly unverified until evidence clears admission.

truth_invariants.note: These values describe the current known project baseline when this contract was authored; runtime must replace them only with independently verified evidence, never with this static file.
